events.name: Awake
events.description: Awake is called when an enabled script instance is being loaded.

events.name: OnEnable
events.description: This function is called when the object becomes enabled and active.

events.name: Start
events.description: Start is called on the frame when a script is enabled just before any of the Update methods are called the first time.

events.name: FixedUpdate
events.description: Frame-rate independent MonoBehaviour.FixedUpdate message for physics calculations.

events.name: Update
events.description: Update is called every frame, if the MonoBehaviour is enabled.

events.name: LateUpdate
events.description: LateUpdate is called every frame, if the Behaviour is enabled, after all Update functions have been called.

events.name: OnDisable
events.description: This function is called when the behaviour becomes disabled or inactive.

events.name: OnDestroy
events.description: Destroying the attached Behaviour will result in the game or Scene receiving OnDestroy.

events.name: OnTriggerEnter
events.description: When a GameObject collides with another GameObject, Unity calls OnTriggerEnter.

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: The other Collider involved in this collision.

events.name: OnTriggerStay
events.description: OnTriggerStay is called almost all the frames for every Collider other that is touching the trigger.

events.name: OnTriggerExit
events.description: OnTriggerExit is called when the Collider other has stopped touching the trigger.

events.name: OnTriggerEnter2D
events.description: Sent when another object enters a trigger collider attached to this object (2D physics only).

events.name: OnTriggerStay2D
events.description: Sent each frame where another object is within a trigger collider attached to this object (2D physics only).

events.name: OnTriggerExit2D
events.description: Sent when another object leaves a trigger collider attached to this object (2D physics only).

events.name: OnCollisionEnter
events.description: OnCollisionEnter is called when this collider/rigidbody has begun touching another rigidbody/collider.

events.name: OnCollisionStay
events.description: OnCollisionStay is called once per frame for every collider/rigidbody that is touching rigidbody/collider.

events.name: OnCollisionExit
events.description: OnCollisionExit is called when this collider/rigidbody has stopped touching another rigidbody/collider.

events.name: OnCollisionEnter2D
events.description: Sent when an incoming collider makes contact with this object's collider (2D physics only).

events.name: OnCollisionStay2D
events.description: Sent each frame where a collider on another object is touching this object's collider (2D physics only).

events.name: OnCollisionExit2D
events.description: Sent when a collider on another object stops touching this object's collider (2D physics only).

events.name: OnControllerColliderHit
events.description: OnControllerColliderHit is called when the controller hits a collider while performing a Move.

events.name: OnJointBreak
events.description: Called when a joint attached to the same game object broke.

events.name: OnJointBreak2D
events.description: Called when a Joint2D attached to the same game object breaks.

events.name: OnGUI
events.description: OnGUI is called for rendering and handling GUI events.

events.name: OnDrawGizmos
events.description: Implement OnDrawGizmos if you want to draw gizmos that are also pickable and always drawn.

events.name: OnDrawGizmosSelected
events.description: Implement OnDrawGizmosSelected to draw a gizmo if the object is selected.

events.name: OnValidate
events.description: Editor-only function that Unity calls when the script is loaded or a value changes in the Inspector.

events.name: Reset
events.description: Reset to default values.

events.name: OnApplicationFocus
events.description: Sent to all GameObjects when the player gets or loses focus.

events.name: OnApplicationPause
events.description: Sent to all GameObjects when the application pauses.

events.name: OnApplicationQuit
events.description: Sent to all game objects before the application quits.

events.name: OnAnimatorIK
events.description: Callback for setting up animation IK (inverse kinematics).

events.name: OnAnimatorMove
events.description: Callback for processing animation movements for modifying root motion.

events.name: OnAudioFilterRead
events.description: If OnAudioFilterRead is implemented, Unity will insert a custom filter into the audio DSP chain.

events.name: OnBecameVisible
events.description: OnBecameVisible is called when the renderer became visible by any camera.

events.name: OnBecameInvisible
events.description: OnBecameInvisible is called when the renderer is no longer visible by any camera.

events.name: OnWillRenderObject
events.description: OnWillRenderObject is called for each camera if the object is visible and not a UI element.

events.name: OnPreCull
events.description: OnPreCull is called before a camera culls the scene.

events.name: OnPreRender
events.description: OnPreRender is called before a camera starts rendering the scene.

events.name: OnPostRender
events.description: OnPostRender is called after a camera finishes rendering the scene.

events.name: OnRenderObject
events.description: OnRenderObject is called after camera has rendered the Scene.

events.name: OnRenderImage
events.description: OnRenderImage is called after all rendering is complete to render image.

events.name: OnParticleCollision
events.description: OnParticleCollision is called when a particle hits a collider.

events.name: OnParticleTrigger
events.description: OnParticleTrigger is called when any particles in a Particle System meet the conditions in the trigger module.

events.name: OnParticleSystemStopped
events.description: OnParticleSystemStopped is called when all particles in the system have died.

events.name: OnMouseDown
events.description: OnMouseDown is called when the user has pressed the mouse button while over the Collider.

events.name: OnMouseDrag
events.description: OnMouseDrag is called when the user has clicked on a Collider and is still holding down the mouse.

events.name: OnMouseEnter
events.description: Called when the mouse enters the Collider.

events.name: OnMouseExit
events.description: Called when the mouse is not any longer over the Collider.

events.name: OnMouseOver
events.description: Called every frame while the mouse is over the Collider.

events.name: OnMouseUp
events.description: OnMouseUp is called when the user has released the mouse button.

events.name: OnMouseUpAsButton
events.description: OnMouseUpAsButton is only called when the mouse is released over the same Collider as it was pressed on.

events.name: OnTransformChildrenChanged
events.description: Called when the list of children of the transform of the GameObject has changed.

events.name: OnTransformParentChanged
events.description: Called when the parent property of the transform of the GameObject has changed.

events.name: OnBeforeTransformParentChanged
events.description: Called just before the parent property of the transform is about to change.

events.name: OnRectTransformDimensionsChange
events.description: This callback is called if any associated RectTransform has its dimensions changed.

events.name: Awake
events.description: This function is called when the ScriptableObject script is started.

events.name: OnEnable
events.description: This function is called when the object is loaded.

events.name: OnDisable
events.description: This function is called when the scriptable object goes out of scope.

events.name: OnDestroy
events.description: This function is called when the scriptable object will be destroyed.

events.name: OnValidate
events.description: Editor-only function that Unity calls when the script is loaded or a value changes in the Inspector.

events.name: Reset
events.description: Reset to default values.

events.name: OnStateEnter
events.description: Called on the first Update frame when a state machine evaluates this state.

events.name: OnStateUpdate
events.description: Called on each Update frame between OnStateEnter and OnStateExit callbacks.

events.name: OnStateExit
events.description: Called on the last Update frame when a state machine evaluates this state.

events.name: OnStateMove
events.description: Called right after Animator.OnAnimatorMove.

events.name: OnStateIK
events.description: Called right after Animator.OnAnimatorIK.

events.name: OnStateMachineEnter
events.description: Called when a transition starts and the state machine starts to evaluate this state machine.

events.name: OnStateMachineExit
events.description: Called when a transition ends and the state machine finishes evaluating this state machine.

events.name: Awake
events.description: Awake is called when the UIBehaviour instance is being loaded.

events.name: OnEnable
events.description: Called when the UI object becomes enabled and active.

events.name: Start
events.description: Called before the first frame update.

events.name: OnDisable
events.description: Called when the UI object becomes disabled.

events.name: OnDestroy
events.description: Called when the UI object is destroyed.

events.name: OnValidate
events.description: Editor-only callback when serialized values change.

events.name: Reset
events.description: Reset to default values.

events.name: OnRectTransformDimensionsChange
events.description: Called when the dimensions of an associated RectTransform change.

events.name: OnDidApplyAnimationProperties
events.description: Callback when animation clips modify RectTransform/UI properties.

events.name: OnCanvasGroupChanged
events.description: Called when the CanvasGroup state changes.

events.name: OnCanvasHierarchyChanged
events.description: Called when the parent Canvas changes.

events.name: OnTransformParentChanged
events.description: Called when the Transform parent changes.

events.name: OnBeforeTransformParentChanged
events.description: Called before the Transform parent changes.

events.name: IsActive
events.description: Returns true if the GameObject and the Component are active.

events.name: IsDestroyed
events.description: Returns true if the native representation of the behaviour has been destroyed.

events.name: Awake
events.description: Called when the Editor object is created.

events.name: OnEnable
events.description: Called when the Editor object becomes active.

events.name: OnDisable
events.description: Called when the Editor object becomes inactive.

events.name: OnDestroy
events.description: Called when the Editor object is destroyed.

events.name: OnInspectorGUI
events.description: Implement this function to make a custom inspector.

events.name: OnSceneGUI
events.description: Enables the Editor to handle an event in the Scene view.

events.name: CreateInspectorGUI
events.description: Implement this method to make a custom UIElements inspector.

events.name: HasPreviewGUI
events.description: Override this method in subclasses if the editor has a custom preview.

events.name: OnPreviewGUI
events.description: Implement to create your own custom preview for the preview area of the inspector.

events.name: OnInteractivePreviewGUI
events.description: Implement to create your own interactive custom preview.

events.name: RequiresConstantRepaint
events.description: Checks if this editor requires constant repainting in its inspector.

events.name: Awake
events.description: Called as the new window is opened.

events.name: OnEnable
events.description: Called when the window is loaded.

events.name: OnDisable
events.description: Called when the window is closed or disabled.

events.name: OnDestroy
events.description: OnDestroy is called to close the EditorWindow window.

events.name: OnGUI
events.description: Implement your own Editor GUI here.

events.name: CreateGUI
events.description: CreateGUI is called when the EditorWindow's root VisualElement is ready to be populated.

events.name: Update
events.description: Called 100 times per second on all visible windows.

events.name: OnInspectorUpdate
events.description: OnInspectorUpdate is called at 10 frames per second to give the inspector a chance to update.

events.name: OnSelectionChange
events.description: Called whenever the selection has changed.

events.name: OnHierarchyChange
events.description: Handler for message that is sent when an object or group of objects in the hierarchy changes.

events.name: OnProjectChange
events.description: Handler for message that is sent whenever the state of the project changes.

events.name: OnFocus
events.description: Called when the window gets keyboard focus.

events.name: OnLostFocus
events.description: Called when the window loses keyboard focus.

events.name: OnBecameVisible
events.description: Called after the window is added to a container view and becomes visible.

events.name: OnBecameInvisible
events.description: Called before the window is removed or hidden.

events.name: OnGUI
events.description: Override this method to make your own IMGUI based GUI for the property.

events.name: GetPropertyHeight
events.description: Override this method to specify how tall the GUI for this field is in pixels.

events.name: CreatePropertyGUI
events.description: Override this method to make your own UI Toolkit based GUI for the property.

events.name: OnPreprocessTexture
events.description: Add this function in a subclass to get a notification before a texture imports.

events.name: OnPostprocessTexture
events.description: Add this function in a subclass to get a notification when a texture asset has finished importing.

events.name: OnPreprocessModel
events.description: Add this function in a subclass to get a notification before a model (.fbx, .obj, etc.) is imported.

events.name: OnPostprocessModel
events.description: Add this function in a subclass to get a notification when a 3D model has finished importing.

events.name: OnPreprocessAudio
events.description: Add this function in a subclass to get a notification before an audio clip is imported.

events.name: OnPostprocessAudio
events.description: Add this function in a subclass to get a notification when an audio clip has finished importing.

events.name: OnPreprocessAsset
events.description: Add this function in a subclass to get a notification before any asset is imported.

events.name: OnPostprocessAllAssets
events.description: This is called after importing of any number of assets is complete.

events.name: OnImportAsset
events.description: This method must be overridden by the derived class and is called by the Asset pipeline to import files.

events.name: OnNetworkSpawn
events.description: Gets called when the NetworkObject is spawned on the network.

events.name: OnNetworkDespawn
events.description: Gets called when the NetworkObject is despawned.

events.name: OnGainedOwnership
events.description: Called when the local client gains ownership of the NetworkObject.

events.name: OnLostOwnership
events.description: Called when the local client loses ownership of the NetworkObject.
